title: Megawatt
tagline: Eight bare computer halls and 500 megawatts to switch on.
blurb: Eight bare computer halls and 500 megawatts to switch on. Lay cable and cooling pipe, set the racks and send your crew of electricians, pipefitters and riggers to work. Ride out the grid maintenance days, light every hall, then start a fresh site and beat your best!
controls: Q / A / O / P or cursor keys
Build (hold while moving to lay a run)
Quit to title (in pause, press twice)

quote.text: Mine's a game that shows its working, and this one nearly always does

credits.name: Prue Fairley, Baz Pocket and Norm Crabtree for INK & PAPER
